solutionSql:
SELECT s.tracking_code, c.name AS customer_name
FROM shipments AS s
JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = s.customer_id
WHERE s.status = 'delivered'
ORDER BY s.tracking_code;
ambiguities: The starter selects customer_id, which is not in resultColumns. I replaced the select list with tracking_code and customers.name AS customer_name, which needs the join.
notes: Unchanged SQL. Revised text says 'each shipment whose status is delivered', which settles the earlier question of shipment_events versus shipments.status. Both output columns are text (OID 25), as the ticket states. Row counts unchanged: 66 sample, 120 nulls, 43 boundary.
